title: Fixed the V182o RRXR/RRRX condition-number crosswalk bug at its source, on the user's authoritative mapping

claims.text: User supplied the authoritative V182o mapping directly (task-generation markdowns, not independently re-derivable from the NWB fields this session checked): RRXR=35-42, RRRX=43-50 (contiguous), vs C31o/V198o's interleaved 35/37/39/41 vs 36/38/40/42-50. Implemented as a subject-aware crosswalk in both places the mapping was hardcoded: jnwb/session.py (new condition_map_for_stem(), used by get_epochs()) and scripts/archive_oneoff/precompute_tfr_arrays.py (new condition_numbers_for(), used by p1_onsets_s() and by extract_lfp_coupling_matrices.py's own p1_onsets_and_conditions_s()). All four call sites now branch on 'V182o' appearing in the NWB filename/stem.
claims.receipt: python one-liner: condition_numbers_for('sub-C31o_ses-230816_rec.nwb')['RRXR'] == (35,37,39,41) [unchanged]; condition_numbers_for('sub-V182o_ses-260629.nwb')['RRXR'] == (35,36,37,38,39,40,41,42) [now contiguous, matches user's report]

claims.text: Grepped every figure script and scripts/*.py for consumers of the affected fields (q2_range_hz, q2_p, q2_best_position, knows_when) -- only classify_omission_units_grand.py itself references them. No figure (1-7) built this session or earlier reads these fields; fig02/fig03 use omission_class/q1_effect_hz (Q1), which is computed from RXRR alone, not RRXR/RRRX. The bug is real and now fixed at the source, but had zero effect on any currently-shipped figure or statistic.
